The loading view reloads every 30s via setTimeout, so off-host or non-http URLs yield an infinite reload loop instead of an error. This is genuine broken behavior introduced by the diff, though severity is low (UX, gated by referer-host check).

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, `embed_url = params.require(:embed_url)` is used directly to look up an existing TopicEmbed and, if none exists, it always enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading` (30s reload) without validating `embed_url` (scheme/host) (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:10-20). The actual validation happens later in TopicRetriever#invalid_host? via `URI(@embed_url).host` and host comparison (lib/topic_retriever.rb:17-25), and if invalid/off-host it simply prevents `perform_retrieve` and returns silently (lib/topic_retriever.rb:12-14). Therefore an invalid or off-host `embed_url` can deterministically produce a perpetual loading+reload loop rather than an error, matching the finding.
